sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes action speed buffs and Cost recovery speed buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Removes frenzy.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Element of Destiny (all stats are boosted by 50%, critical hit rate is boosted by 50%, and max HP is boosted 50%) to the allied field for 120 seconds.
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 20% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +150
